title: Injuries
description: injuries.json (spec §3.8): picked by weight when a party member goes Out. Documentation only: the C# loader (Tactics.Logic PackLoader and Validation) is the authority and also checks meaning (spec §4.10).

hook.description: When the injury's effects run on its owner, e.g. onBattleStart.

effects.description: Effects run on the owner on the hook (Deep cut: bleeding at the start of each battle).
